source:
@@U03583@@
Toward us on the wide waves gliding? As if by the wind’s contriving We behold white sails arriving! Brightly they dance before our eyes, These maidens of sea’s paradise! Let’s climb down! Hear their voices! Already my fond heart rejoices.

@@U03585@@
What we bring you here tonight Will give pleasure and delight. In Chelone’s giant shell Are austere gods, so praise them well. Gods of radiant light we bring, So let us all in glory sing!

@@U03587@@
Small to the sight, Potent in might, They save sailors at sea From ancient antiquity.

@@U03589@@
We bring you the 卡比里诸神 To keep the revels cheery, Where they hold sacred sway 涅普顿 smoothes the way.

@@U03591@@
We yield to you, the stronger, For when the sea’s great anger A mighty ship has wrecked, Youre there the crew to protect.

@@U03593@@
Here we've brought three, The fourth wouldn't come. He said he’s the best, And thinks for the rest.
translation:
@@U03583@@
宽阔的波浪向我们滑行？仿佛风的吹拂，我们看到白帆到达！她们在我们眼前翩翩起舞，这些海洋天堂的少女！我们爬下来吧！听听他们的声音！我的心已经很高兴了。

@@U03585@@
今晚我们为您带来的将会给您带来快乐和喜悦。切洛尼巨大的贝壳里住着严肃的神灵，所以要好好赞美他们。我们带来光芒四射的诸神，让我们在荣耀中歌唱！

@@U03587@@
看似渺小，力量强大，自古以来拯救海上水手。

@@U03589@@
我们为您带来卡比里诸神，让狂欢保持欢乐，在他们神圣的统治下，涅普顿为您铺平道路。

@@U03591@@
我们屈服于你，更强大的人，因为当大海的愤怒使一艘强大的船只失事时，你是船员们的保护者。

@@U03593@@
我们带来了三个，第四个不会来。他说他是最好的，并为其他人着想。
